Name: Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes THAI
Author: CakekungXD
Description:
[center][b]🇹🇭 Thai Translation Mod
[/b][/center]
This is a [b]Thai translation mod[/b] for [Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes with SVE Support (Content Patcher)]. This mod only provides the Thai translation, so [b]please download and install the original mod first[/b] before using this translation.

[center][b]Required original file:[/b][/center]
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950?tab=images

⚠️ Notes
Since this is [b]my first translation mod[/b], there may still be some mistakes, such as incomplete translations, dialogue that I may have missed, or other bugs that could occur during use.
If you encounter any problems or find dialogue that hasn't been translated yet, [b]feel free to report it in the comments/post[/b]. I'll do my best to investigate and fix the issues in future updates.
Thank you to everyone who gives my translation a try, and of course, thank you to the original creator for making this mod possible in the first place.
[b]Thank you! ❤️[/b]
[quote][b]P.S.[/b] If you find that some image files don't match the original mod, or that certain images fail to load, please keep in mind that [b]this is not caused by my translation mod[/b]. The image files come directly from the original mod. Please report those issues to the [b]original mod creator[/b] instead.[/quote]
